# `deployment`

- [Events](#events)

## Events

### <a id="signoz-deployment"></a>`signoz.deployment`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A deployment of a service.

The event SHOULD be associated with one of the following entities:

- `service`
- `deployment`

`service.name`, `service.version` and `deployment.environment.name` are
set on the Resource. Severity is `INFO` (9) for `succeeded` and `ERROR`
(17) for `failed`.
